candidates.change_summary: Replace block.number + 1 with block.number so that the guess can be settled in the same block instead of the next block.
Replace msg.value == 1 ether with msg.value == 0 ether, changing the payment required to lock in a guess.
Delete the require(msg.value == 1 ether) check so no payment is required.
Change the state variable updated from guesses[msg.sender] to guesses[tx.origin] so the guess is stored for tx.origin instead of msg.sender.
Remove the require(guesses[msg.sender].block == 0) guard so lockInGuess no longer reverts when the caller already has an active guess block.
Change the msg.value check from 1 ether to a different amount so calls that would otherwise revert now succeed.
Change the stored guess assignment to assign zero instead, altering the recorded commitment.
Change the stored block to the current block number instead of block.number + 1, altering when settle can be called.
Delete the require that checks answer != 0 before transferring funds, so a zero blockhash combined with a matching guess will transfer ether.
Change the transfer amount from 2 ether to 1 ether, altering the external balance change.
Remove the condition guesses[msg.sender].guess == answer so any non-zero blockhash triggers the transfer.
Delete the block number require check, allowing settle to be called immediately after lockInGuess in the same block.
Delete the require that guesses[msg.sender].block != 0, allowing settle to be called without a prior lockInGuess, which resets block to 0 and may affect transfers.
Delete the require that the guess block is nonzero, allowing settle to proceed for accounts that never locked in a guess.
Change the settle maturity check to require the current block be before the stored guess block instead of after it.
Use the current blockhash instead of the stored guess block's blockhash when computing the answer.
Insert an additional require that the current blockhash be nonzero before clearing the stored guess block.
Remove the nonzero-answer condition so a zero answer can be treated as a correct guess.
Set the stored guess block to 1 instead of 0 when settling, preventing immediate resettlement after the first successful settle.
Delete the require that the caller must already have a guess, allowing settle to proceed even when guesses[msg.sender].block is zero.
Change the settle block-number check from strict greater-than to greater-than-or-equal, so it can complete at exactly the recorded block instead of reverting.
Replace the answer hash lookup with a pass-through of the stored guess, making the comparison always succeed when the guess is nonzero.
Delete the reset of the caller's guess block before the payout check, so state is not cleared during settlement.
Replace the conditional payout guard with a direct require, changing settlement from a possible no-op completion to a revert when the guess does not match.
Change the payout transfer amount from 2 ether to 1 ether, altering the observable balance outcome on a successful settle.
Move the state update clearing the caller's guess block from before the payout check to after the external transfer call.
